name: Secret Sources
description: Pull host passwords and keys from 1Password, Bitwarden, Infisical, HashiCorp Vault, KeePass, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud when you connect instead of storing them in Termix.
features: Works with 1Password, Infisical, Bitwarden, Vaultwarden, HashiCorp Vault, KeePass files, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault and Google Cloud
Use references like op://vault/item/field or vault://secret/app#password in a host's password or key fields
Secrets are fetched each time you connect and never stored in Termix
Bitwarden and Vaultwarden users can each unlock their own vault with SSO, email or an API key
